name: Percent Frame Window
description: Frame window counter (240 TPS) for percent-macro position macros: how many ticks earlier/later each click and release can be and still pass.

scan-radius.name: Scan radius (ticks)
scan-radius.description: Maximum ticks tested on each side of the recorded input.

thorough-scan.name: Thorough scan
thorough-scan.description: Test EVERY offset in the radius instead of stopping at the first fail on each side. Slower, but finds separate passing islands.

probe-beyond.name: Probe beyond first fail
probe-beyond.description: Extra offsets tested past the first fail on each side to detect islands (ignored in thorough mode).

verify-boundaries.name: Verify boundaries
verify-boundaries.description: Run each boundary offset twice. A disagreement shrinks the window and marks it UNSTABLE.

only-action.name: Only action #
only-action.description: Analyse only the input containing this action number (1 = first data line). 0 = analyse everything.

horizon-groups.name: Survive N following inputs
horizon-groups.description: A trial passes if the player survives until this many later inputs (same player) fired.

horizon-min-ticks.name: Survive at least (ticks)
horizon-min-ticks.description: ...and at least this many ticks after the tested input.

horizon-to-end.name: Survive to end of run
horizon-to-end.description: Strictest: survive until the end of the reference run.

speed.name: Speed (updates per frame)
speed.description: How many 1/60s game updates run per real frame while analysing. Lower it if the game stutters.

expected-tps.name: Expected TPS
expected-tps.description: Physics ticks per second the results are labelled with. A warning is shown if the game actually runs differently.

x-epsilon.name: X tolerance
x-epsilon.description: Playback fires an input when player x >= action x - this value.

macros-dir.name: Macros folder
macros-dir.description: Leave empty to use the percent-macro mod's folder: .../save/geode/mods/yourname.percentmacro/macros

save-report.name: Save report files
save-report.description: Write <macro>.windows.txt and .csv to this mod's save folder under results/.

settings-button.name: Settings button
settings-button.description: Adds a FW Settings button to the pause menu.
